Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 08/28/2026
Patient: Guillermo Arredondo, 75 y/o M

CC: L leg pain

HPI: Pt c/o L leg radic pain. No prior ESI. PSH: no spinal surgery. ROS neg fevers/chills/wt loss, no B/B sx, no h/o CA.

PE: Neuro exam shows decreased sensation in L4-L5 dermatomes, mild weakness in L ankle dorsiflexion. Reflexes diminished at L knee.

Pain Management Consultation
Date: 09/07/2026
Patient: Guillermo Arredondo, 75 y/o M

CC: LBP x3 wks w/ radiation to L LE.

HPI: Pt reports low back pain ongoing for 3 weeks, radiating to left lower extremity. No prior interventions noted.

PE: Limited lumbar ROM due to pain. Neurologic exam shows decreased sensation in L LE dermatomes. Motor strength 4/5 in L leg muscles.

Assessment: LBP x3 wks w/ radiation to L LE consistent with radiculopathy.

Plan: Recommend MRI lumbar spine to evaluate nerve root involvement. Initiate NSAIDs and consider physical therapy. Follow-up in 2 weeks to assess response and plan further management.
